leadText: Yveltal (Japanese: イベルタル Yveltal) is a major character in Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction.
plainText:
Yveltal (Japanese: イベルタル Yveltal) is a major character in Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction.

==In the movies==
 
Hundreds of years prior to the 's events, Yveltal almost destroyed all life in Allearth Forest. saved and many other Pokémon from the destruction, and later reversed all of the damage that Yveltal inflicted. After these events, Yveltal turned into a giant cocoon and slumbered until the present day.

During that time, Argus and Millis Steel, Merilyn, and Riot were fighting over who should catch . They eventually took their fighting to an underground pool where Yveltal slept in its cocoon form. The fighting eventually awakened Yveltal, and it immediately activated its and used to petrify large areas of the forest, as well as , Merilyn, Riot, the Carbink servants (save for Dace), and the Steels, who tried to stop it with missiles from their ship. and tried to battle Yveltal as well, but almost fell off a cliff, with Pikachu being petrified in the process. Diancie Mega Evolved and created a large diamond, which she used to protect Ash, , , and from another Oblivion Wing. Yveltal used Oblivion Wing once again to finish them off, but the attack was intercepted by Xerneas' Aurora Beam. Yveltal, still in its Dark Aura state, used Shadow Ball, which Xerneas intercepted with another Aurora Beam before using its Fairy Aura to successfully calm Yveltal. With nothing more to do, it flew away peacefully.

Yveltal was last seen flying through a mountainous area at night during the ending credits.

===Personality and characteristics===
Yveltal appears to be a very destructive Pokémon, destroying the Allearth Forest with its , particularly seeking to destroy those who disturbed its sleep in the form of a cocoon as payment for disturbing it. This is also seen when it destroyed all life in the Allearth Forest years prior to the events of the movie. However, Yveltal is not always openly destructive, as it left in peace once Xerneas calmed it with its Fairy Aura.

===Merchandise===
====Yveltal Movie Commemoration Set====
The second of 4 packs to be released on July 19, 2014 was the Yveltal Movie Commemoration Set (Japanese: 映画公開記念　イベルタルセット), which includes a Cracked Ice Reverse Holofoil promotional card of the Destruction Pokémon . A similar selection of booster packs to the Xerneas Set are packaged with it, including 2 from , 2 from , and 2 from . An application postcard for the prize lottery to be run in September 2014 was also included.

Promotional card:
( 52)

Product image:
 

====Theater Diancie Movie Commemoration Set====
The third pack released on July 19, 2014 was the Theater Diancie Movie Commemoration Set (Japanese: 映画公開記念　ディアンシーセット＜劇場・ポケモンセンター限定＞ Movie Commemoration Diancie Set ), 1 of 2 products to feature the Jewel Pokémon in its Japanese TCG debut. The set contains the titular Diancie promotional card, as well as 1 booster pack from , 1 from , 1 from , and 1 from . A prize lottery application postcard is also included. Unlike the Xerneas and Yveltal sets, this one could only be purchased at Pokémon Centers or at participating cinemas showing Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction.

Promotional card:
( 53)

Product image:
 

====Seven & I Diancie Movie Commemoration Set====
Another Diancie-related product was the final pack first made available on July 19, 2014. The Seven & I Diancie Movie Commemoration Set (Japanese: 映画公開記念　ディアンシーセット＜セブン&アイ・ポケモンセンター限定＞ Movie Commemoration Diancie Set ) contains the same assortment of booster packs as the previous version, as well as the same Diancie promotional card albeit with different artwork. This set was exclusive to Pokémon Centers and store chains owned by , such as and . As with the other sets, an application postcard for the prize lottery to be run in September 2014 was also included.

Promotional card:
( 54)

Product image:
 

==Trivia==
Yveltal played a similar role to the Meta Groudon from Jirachi: Wish Maker, also released on July 19. Both are the generation's red game mascots, started a rampage in which they absorbed life energy from plants, people and Pokémon, including and the film's antagonist or antagonists, and were stopped by another of the featured Pokémon in the movie (Xerneas or ), who revived everyone and everything they absorbed energy from before going to sleep.
